subject: C6i: BGR5A1 (43) SAMPLING needs Rust planner admission (black home)
body: c6hc black home = backboardd TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_REFUSED rc=-13 neutral image (downsample_4 sampling a 565x1220 f43 usage5 0x20 texture) -> command invalid -> frame dropped. Frontend fixed (render_encoder.inc tegu_generic_texture_ok admits 43, bpp2; n2t/gd_format already map RGB5_A1_UNORM/BGRA). Remaining refusal is Rust: gpu/metal/tegu/air_bridge.rs ~1342-1360 'texture facts outside bounded read-only 2D/array/sphere-volume classes': add 43 to sampled_format matches!(r.format,1|10|30|70|80|115) and to bounded_2d's matches! (and the 776x24x10 f43 pyramid goes through rich_mip_2d). Translator view format must map 43<->VK A1R5G5B5_UNORM_PACK16. Host repro: gpu/build/c6f-lowering-20261026/ca_backboardd_host_test.py prints C6F_PENDING until then.
